sections.heading: What is Retirement Planning?
sections.text: Preparing financially for life after you stop working.

sections.heading: Why Important
sections.text: No regular income, rising expenses, and longer life expectancy.

sections.heading: Start Early
sections.text: Early investing allows more time for compounding.

sections.heading: How Much to Save
sections.text: Save 15–20% of income for long-term goals.

sections.heading: Steps
sections.text: Set goals → estimate expenses → invest regularly → review plan.

sections.heading: Common Mistakes
sections.text:
- Starting late
- Ignoring inflation
- Not investing
